<script>
/* YouTube video popup fix: Kadence video-popup blocks build the player via
   YT.Player (YouTube IFrame API from youtube.com), which SP blocks on decline
   (rotating-hash widgetapi entry) -> YT.Player never defined -> popup spins
   forever. Preloading the nocookie IFrame API doesn't help (YT already
   partially defined -> no-op). Fix: intercept the popup click in the capture
   phase and open our own overlay with a plain youtube-nocookie.com/embed
   iframe (native player, no YT.Player dependency) -> plays cookielessly
   regardless of SP blocking youtube.com. Non-YouTube popups are untouched. */
(function () {
  if (window.__ampYtOverlay) return;
  window.__ampYtOverlay = true;

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var link = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.kadence-video-popup-link');
    if (!link) return;

    var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
    var m = href.match(/(?:youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com\/embed\/|youtu\.be\/|[?&]v=)([\w-]{6,})/);
    if (!m) return; // not a YouTube popup — let Kadence handle it

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation(); // beat Kadence's own handler (capture phase)

    var id = m[1];
    var ov = document.createElement('div');
    ov.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:min(90vw,960px);aspect-ratio:16/9;';

    var ifr = document.createElement('iframe');
    ifr.src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/' + id + '?autoplay=1&rel=0';
    ifr.setAttribute('allow', 'autoplay; encrypted-media; fullscreen');
    ifr.setAttribute('allowfullscreen', '');
    ifr.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;';

    var close = document.createElement('button');
    close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close video');
    close.textContent = '✕';
    close.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:-40px;right:0;font-size:28px;line-height:1;color:#fff;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;';

    wrap.appendChild(ifr);
    wrap.appendChild(close);
    ov.appendChild(wrap);
    document.body.appendChild(ov);

    var kill = function () { ov.remove(); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
    var onKey = function (ev) { if (ev.key === 'Escape') kill(); };
    close.addEventListener('click', kill);
    ov.addEventListener('click', function (ev) { if (ev.target === ov) kill(); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, true); // capture — runs before Kadence's bubble handler
})();
</script><script>
(function () {
  if (window.__ampYtVisibilityFix) return;
  window.__ampYtVisibilityFix = true;

  var POLL_INTERVAL = 50;
  var POLL_TIMEOUT = 3000;

  function unhide(frame) {
    if (frame.style.display === 'none') {
      frame.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  function isYoutubeManagedFrame(node) {
    return (
      node.nodeType === 1 &&
      node.tagName === 'IFRAME' &&
      node.getAttribute('sp-consent') === 'Youtube'
    );
  }

  function unhideIfReady(frame) {
    if ((frame.getAttribute('src') || '').trim() !== '') {
      unhide(frame);
    }
  }

  function sweepBackgroundIframes(root) {
    var frames = (root || document).querySelectorAll('iframe[sp-consent="Youtube"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
      unhideIfReady(frames[i]);
    }
  }

  function paintPoster(wrap, frame) {
    if (wrap.dataset.ampPosterSet) return;
    var m = frame.src.match(/embed\/([\w-]{6,})/);
    if (!m) return;
    wrap.style.background =
      'center / cover no-repeat url(https://img.youtube.com/vi/' + m[1] + '/hqdefault.jpg)';
    wrap.dataset.ampPosterSet = '1';
  }

  function handleLightbox(lightboxNode) {
    var elapsed = 0;
    var poll = setInterval(function () {
      elapsed += POLL_INTERVAL;
      var wrap = lightboxNode.querySelector('.lightbox__image-wrapper');
      var frame = wrap ? wrap.querySelector('iframe[src*="youtube"]') : null;
      if (frame) {
        paintPoster(wrap, frame);
        unhide(frame);
      }
      if (!document.body.contains(lightboxNode) || elapsed >= POLL_TIMEOUT) {
        clearInterval(poll);
      }
    }, POLL_INTERVAL);
  }

  var observer = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
    for (var i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
      var added = mutations[i].addedNodes;
      for (var j = 0; j < added.length; j++) {
        var node = added[j];
        if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;

        if (node.classList && node.classList.contains('lightbox')) {
          handleLightbox(node);
        }

        // the youtube iframe itself just got inserted (possibly already
        // carrying sp-consent + display:none if SP tagged it inline)
        if (isYoutubeManagedFrame(node)) {
          unhideIfReady(node);
        } else if (node.querySelectorAll) {
          sweepBackgroundIframes(node);
        }
      }

      var t = mutations[i].target;
      if (mutations[i].type === 'attributes' && isYoutubeManagedFrame(t)) {
        unhideIfReady(t);
      }
    }
  });
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['style', 'src', 'sp-consent'],
  });

  // Safety net sweeps: once at script run (near-certain no-op, parser hasn't
  // reached the markup yet), once at DOMContentLoaded, and a short poll
  // after that in case SP's async CMP script is still mid-flight.
  sweepBackgroundIframes();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    sweepBackgroundIframes();
    var elapsed = 0;
    var poll = setInterval(function () {
      elapsed += POLL_INTERVAL;
      sweepBackgroundIframes();
      if (elapsed >= POLL_TIMEOUT) clearInterval(poll);
    }, POLL_INTERVAL);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/**
 * Amplify global modal orchestrator.
 *
 * Governs six surfaces: the SecurePrivacy cookie banner, the "Your Privacy
 * Choices" preference centre, the blocks-extended content/contact modals, the
 * Salespeak AI-search chat, the Salesforce Embedded Messaging chat, and the
 * theme's React site-search modal.
 *
 * Standalone, dependency-free, no build step. Load it with a plain <script> tag.
 *
 * LOAD IT IN <head>, BEFORE EVERYTHING ELSE.
 *
 * The hard reason is listener order. Capture-phase listeners on `document` fire
 * in registration order, and the Salesforce chat snippet installs one that calls
 * stopImmediatePropagation(). Whichever registers first wins, permanently -- if
 * that snippet gets there first, this file never sees a click on the chat link
 * and cannot gate it. The snippet is inline in the page body, so anything in
 * <head> beats it.
 *
 * A softer reason: captureDeepLink() must strip a ?modal= param before the
 * blocks-extended modal service reads the URL. That happens on DOMContentLoaded,
 * so any position before then would do -- <head> simply has the most margin.
 *
 * WHAT IT ENFORCES
 *
 *   1. Cookie banner first. While the consent flow is unresolved, no other
 *      modal, drawer or chat may open. Clicks on their triggers are swallowed
 *      silently -- no visual response, no console noise.
 *
 *      "The consent flow" is wider than the banner. Pressing Customize hides
 *      the banner and opens the preference centre, so the banner alone is not a
 *      reliable end-of-flow signal: the visitor has answered nothing yet. The
 *      panel therefore keeps the gate shut and is itself the blocking surface
 *      until a choice is saved. Only then does it become an ordinary,
 *      equal-priority modal, which is what the footer link opens.
 *   2. One active surface. Outside the consent flow every registered widget is
 *      equal priority. Triggering one closes whatever is already open, and the
 *      previous surface is fully gone (shell, backdrop, focus trap) before the
 *      next one activates.
 *
 * WHY IT LOOKS LIKE THIS
 *
 * None of the widgets it governs are ours to change: three are vendor iframes
 * (SecurePrivacy, Salespeak, Salesforce) and two are React trees owned by other
 * bundles. So the orchestrator drives them from the outside through whatever
 * control surface each one already exposes, and never assumes it was the one

         * Ask permission to open, for widgets that call in rather than being
         * intercepted. Returns false when the consent gate is shut, in which
         * case the caller must do nothing at all.
         *
         * @param {string} id Descriptor id.
         *
         * @return {Promise<boolean>} Whether opening is allowed.
         */
        requestOpen( id ) {
            if ( isBlocked() ) {
                return Promise.resolve( false );
            }
            return closeOthers( id ).then( function () {
                return true;
            } );
        },

        /**
         * Tell the manager a widget opened itself, so the previous surface is
         * torn down. Optional -- reconcile() catches this anyway.
         *
         * @param {string} id Descriptor id.
         */
        notifyOpened( id ) {
            const entry = manager.get( id );
            if ( entry ) {
                entry._openedAt = ++openSequence;
                entry._wasOpen = true;
            }
            scheduleReconcile();
        },

        notifyClosed() {
            scheduleReconcile();
        },

        get( id ) {
            for ( let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++ ) {
                if ( entries[ i ].id === id ) {
                    return entries[ i ];
                }
            }
            return null;
        },

        getActive() {
            const active = getActive();
            return active ? active.id : null;
        },

        isBlocked,

        closeAll() {
            return closeOthers( null );
        },

        /** @return {Array} Registered ids and their live state, for debugging. */
        inspect() {
            return entries.map( function ( entry ) {
                return {
                    id: entry.id,
                    priority: priorityOf( entry ),
                    open: isEntryOpen( entry ),
                };
            } );
        },
    };

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- adapters
    //
    // Everything below is the only part that knows vendor selectors. Each
    // adapter is just the control surface that widget already exposes.

    /**
     * SecurePrivacy consent banner -- the one blocking surface.
     *
     * Only the visitor may resolve it, so close() is intentionally a no-op:
     * the orchestrator gates on it, it never dismisses it.
     */
    function registerCookieBanner() {
        manager.register( {
            id: 'cookie-banner',
            priority: 'blocking',
            isOpen: bannerPresent,
            close: noop,
        } );
    }

    /**
     * "Your Privacy Choices" preference centre.
     *
     * Equal priority once consent is resolved, per the AC -- it is only special
     * during the first-visit flow, and there it is the banner's own Customize
     * surface rather than this one.
     */
    const PRIVACY_ATTR = 'data-amplify-privacy-choices';
    const PRIVACY_TEXT = 'your privacy choices';

    /**
     * Tag the footer link by text so it has a stable CSS selector.
     *
     * The footer markup gives it no id or distinguishing class, and CSS cannot
     * match on text, so the orchestrator brands it once and matches the brand.
     */
    function tagPrivacyLink() {
        if ( query( '[' + PRIVACY_ATTR + ']' ) ) {
            return;
        }
        const links = document.querySelectorAll(
            '#footer-navigation a, .footer__navigation-link'
        );
        for ( let i = 0; i < links.length; i++ ) {
            const text = ( links[ i ].textContent || '' ).trim().toLowerCase();
            if ( text === PRIVACY_TEXT ) {
                links[ i ].setAttribute( PRIVACY_ATTR, '' );
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    function registerPrivacyChoices() {
        manager.register( {
            id: 'privacy-choices',
            triggerSelector: '[' + PRIVACY_ATTR + ']',
            handlesEscape: false,
            restoresFocus: false,
            // Blocking while it IS the consent flow, ordinary afterwards --
            // which is precisely what the AC asks for. Reached from the banner's
            // "Customize" button it is the visitor still answering the consent
            // question, so nothing else may open and, just as importantly, the
            // panel must not be torn down by a takeover. Reached from the footer
            // link after consent, it is an equal-priority modal like any other.
            priority() {
                return consentSettled ? 'normal' : 'blocking';
            },
            isOpen: prefCentrePresent,
            close() {
                if ( spHas( 'hidePreferenceCenter' ) ) {
                    window.sp.hidePreferenceCenter();
                }
            },
            open() {
                if (
                    ! window.sp ||
                    typeof window.sp.openPreferenceCenter !== 'function'
                ) {
                    throw new Error( 'SecurePrivacy is not loaded' );
                }
                window.sp.openPreferenceCenter();
            },
        } );
    }

    /**
     * Contact sales / contact form modals from wp-plugin-amplify-blocks-extended.
     *
     * Its React shell is mounted only while open, so a visible .modal-overlay is
     * an exact open signal -- except for the theme's legacy static shell, which
     * always carries .is-hidden.
     */
    function contactModalNode() {
        const overlays = document.querySelectorAll(
            '.modal-overlay:not(.is-hidden)'
        );
        for ( let i = 0; i < overlays.length; i++ ) {
            if ( isVisible( overlays[ i ] ) ) {
                return overlays[ i ];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Salesforce Embedded Messaging (MIAW) chat.
     *
     * Its bootstrap exposes exactly one half of what we need. utilAPI has
     * launchChat() but no closeChat/minimizeChat/endChat -- the only methods are
     * getEmbeddedMessagingFrame, prefetchResources, showChatButton,
     * hideChatButton, launchChat, sendTextMessage and removeAllComponents. So
     * opening is a native call and closing is not.
     *
     * So close() sends `{ method: 'ESW_APP_MINIMIZE' }` INTO the frame, which is
     * what the minimise button does, and the frame handles the rest: it switches
     * its own view to the minimised bubble and then tells the parent to shrink
     * and reposition, dropping .isMaximized for .isMinimized and clearing the
     * #embeddedMessagingModalOverlay backdrop.
     *
     * The direction matters, and getting it wrong is visible. Dispatching a
     * synthetic same-origin MessageEvent at the parent instead -- faking the
     * notification the frame would have sent -- makes the parent resize the frame
     * to 62px while the frame is still rendering the full chat, so the pill shows
     * a cropped fragment of the chat header rather than the bubble icon. The
     * frame owns its minimised view; only the frame can switch to it.
     *
     * (removeAllComponents() would also clear the screen, but it destroys the
     * widget rather than closing it, and the visitor could not reopen the chat.)
     *
     * Minimise, not end-conversation, is the right meaning of "close" here: it
     * removes the shell and the backdrop while preserving the visitor's
     * conversation, so a modal takeover does not silently discard their chat.
     */
    const SF_FRAME_ID = 'embeddedMessagingFrame';

    function sfChatFrame() {
        return query( '#' + SF_FRAME_ID );
    }

    function registerSalesforceChat() {
        manager.register( {
            id: 'sf-chat',
            // The site's own script intercepts *every* [data-modal-id="<chat id>"]
            // link on the page, but the only one it renders is the chat item in
            // its Contact Sales dropdown. Matching that keeps this adapter from
            // claiming ordinary content-modal triggers, and because content-modal
            // replays clicks rather than calling the modal service directly, any
            // link the site hijacks still ends up doing the right thing.
            triggerSelector: '.sf-contact-sales__chat-item a[data-modal-id]',
            handlesEscape: false,
            restoresFocus: false,
            isOpen() {
                const frame = sfChatFrame();
                // A minimised chat is a pill, not a modal, so it does not count
                // as the active surface -- only the maximised window does. The
                // pill therefore stays on screen after a takeover, which is
                // intended: it is how the visitor gets their conversation back.
                // Re-maximising from it is not a registered trigger, so it is
                // reconcile() rather than onCaptureClick() that notices and
                // closes whatever else was open.
                return !! frame && frame.classList.contains( 'isMaximized' );
            },
            close() {
                const frame = sfChatFrame();
                if ( ! frame || ! frame.contentWindow ) {
                    return;
                }
                let origin;
                try {
                    // Read the origin off the frame rather than hard-coding it:
                    // it differs between the sandbox and production orgs.
                    origin = new URL( frame.src ).origin;
                } catch {
                    return;
                }
                frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
                    {
                        method: 'ESW_APP_MINIMIZE',
                        data: { hasMinimizedNotification: false },
                    },
                    origin
                );
            },
            // Deliberately no open(): the click is replayed so the site's own
            // handler runs, which is what enforces Salesforce business hours.
            // Calling utilAPI.launchChat() here would open the chat outside
            // business hours -- verified: launchChat() resolves happily with
            // businessHoursState 'closed', because that gate is client-side only.
        } );
    }

    function openContactModal( id ) {
        if ( window.Modals && typeof window.Modals.open === 'function' ) {
            window.Modals.open( id );
            return true;
        }
        if ( typeof window.openModal === 'function' ) {
            window.openModal( id );
            return true;
        }
        warn( 'the blocks-extended modal service is not available' );
        return false;
    }

    function registerContactModal() {
        manager.register( {
            id: 'content-modal',
            triggerSelector: '[data-modal-id], [data-modal-handler]',
            isOpen() {
                return !! contactModalNode();
            },
            close() {
                const modals = window.Modals;
                if ( modals && typeof modals.close === 'function' ) {
                    modals.close();
                    return;
                }
                if ( typeof window.closeModal === 'function' ) {
                    window.closeModal();
                    return;
                }
                // Last resort: press its own close button.
                const node = contactModalNode();
                const button = node && node.querySelector( '.modal-close' );
                if ( button ) {
                    button.click();
                }
            },
            // Deliberately no open(): activate() replays the click instead.
            // Calling window.Modals.open() directly would bypass any other
            // capture-phase interceptor on the same trigger -- the Salesforce
            // chat script claims certain [data-modal-id] links for itself -- and
            // we would open the wrong surface. Replaying the click takes the
            // exact path a real click takes, so whatever should happen, happens.
            // openContactModal() is still used for the deep-link replay, which
            // has no element to click.
        } );
    }

    /**
     * Salespeak AI search chat.
     *
     * Its close control lives inside a cross-origin iframe, so we cannot click
     * it. What the iframe actually does is post `{ closeIframe: true }` to the
     * parent, which Salespeak's own listener turns into a full teardown --
     * drawer classes removed, launcher restored, internal state reset. We
     * reproduce that message. A same-origin postMessage is rejected because the
     * listener checks event.origin, so the event is dispatched directly with the
     * origin set. This also skips the "Rate this conversation" prompt that
     * clicking the real close button raises.
     */
    function salespeakInstance() {
        const instances = window.salespeakLaunchersScriptInstances;
        return instances && instances[ 0 ] ? instances[ 0 ] : null;
    }

    function closeSalespeak() {
        const iframe = query( '#salespeak-iframe' );
        window.dispatchEvent(
            new MessageEvent( 'message', {
                data: { closeIframe: true },
                origin: SALESPEAK_ORIGIN,
                source: iframe ? iframe.contentWindow : null,
            } )
        );
    }

    function registerAiChat() {
        manager.register( {
            id: 'ai-chat',
            triggerSelector: '[data-ai-search]',
            handlesEscape: false,
            restoresFocus: false,
            isOpen() {
                const instance = salespeakInstance();
                if ( instance && typeof instance.isWidgetOpen === 'boolean' ) {
                    return instance.isWidgetOpen;
                }
                return !! query( '#salespeak-widget.iframe-visible' );
            },
            close: closeSalespeak,
            open( trigger ) {
                const instance = salespeakInstance();
                if ( instance && typeof instance.openWidget === 'function' ) {
                    instance.openWidget();
                    return;
                }
                // No instance yet: fall back to the theme's own click path,
                // which knows how to wait for the launcher to arrive.
                if ( trigger ) {
                    const event = new MouseEvent( 'click', {
                        bubbles: true,
                        cancelable: true,
                        view: window,
                    } );
                    event.amplifyOrchestrated = true;
                    trigger.dispatchEvent( event );
                }
            },
        } );
    }

    /**
     * The theme's React site-search modal.
     *
     * Not present on every page (the header renders either this or AI search),
     * so the adapter is registered unconditionally and simply never reports open
     * where the modal does not exist. It owns its own Escape handling and focus
     * trap, so we only need a way to dismiss it: its overlay's click handler is
     * the close callback.
     */
    function registerSiteSearch() {
        manager.register( {
            id: 'site-search',
            triggerSelector: '.search-btn-handler button',
            restoresFocus: false,
            isOpen() {
                return isVisible( query( '.search-modal' ) );
            },
            close() {
                const overlay = query( '.search-modal__overlay' );
                if ( overlay ) {
                    overlay.click();
                }
            },
        } );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ boot

    function bindBannerButtons() {
        const frame = query( '#ifrmCookieBanner' );
        if ( ! frame || frame.dataset.amplifyBound ) {
            return;
        }
        let doc;
        try {
            // The banner iframe is a srcdoc document, so it is same-origin and
            // readable. Guarded anyway in case SecurePrivacy ever changes that.
            doc = frame.contentDocument;
        } catch {
            return;
        }
        if ( ! doc || ! doc.getElementById( 'sp-accept' ) ) {
            return;
        }
        frame.dataset.amplifyBound = '1';

        // Reconcile promptly on any of these rather than waiting for the
        // mutation that hides the banner, so the gate reacts immediately.
        //
        // Accept and Decline end the flow. Customize does NOT -- it swaps the
        // banner for the preference centre, and the visitor has answered
        // nothing yet. All three still need a reconcile because the DOM changed;
        // whether that reconcile opens the gate is consentResolved()'s call, and
        // it keeps it shut while the panel is up.
        const RESOLVING = [ 'sp-accept', 'sp-decline' ];
        [ 'sp-accept', 'sp-decline', 'sp-customize' ].forEach( function ( id ) {
            const button = doc.getElementById( id );
            if ( ! button ) {
                return;
            }
            button.addEventListener( 'click', function () {
                log(
                    RESOLVING.indexOf( id ) === -1
                        ? 'consent flow continues via ' + id
                        : 'consent resolved via ' + id
                );
                window.setTimeout( scheduleReconcile, 0 );
                window.setTimeout( scheduleReconcile, 400 );
            } );
        } );
    }

    /**
     * Extend Escape handling into same-origin iframes.
     *
     * Keyboard events never cross a document boundary, so once focus is inside
     * an iframe the parent page stops seeing keystrokes entirely. SecurePrivacy
     * renders its banner and preference centre as srcdoc iframes, which are
     * same-origin and therefore reachable -- so the same handler is bound inside
     * them and Escape keeps working while focus is in the preference centre.
     *
     * Salespeak's chat is cross-origin and cannot be bridged this way: while
     * focus is inside that drawer, only Salespeak's own code can see Escape.
     */
    function bridgeIframeKeys() {
        const frames = document.querySelectorAll( 'iframe' );
        for ( let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++ ) {
            const frame = frames[ i ];
            // Every step here touches a third-party frame that may be
            // sandboxed, detached mid-loop, or otherwise hostile, so one bad
            // frame must not cost us the rest of them.
            try {
                if ( frame.dataset.amplifyKeyBridge ) {
                    continue;
                }
                const doc = frame.contentDocument;
                if ( ! doc ) {
                    // Cross-origin. Left untagged so a frame that later becomes
                    // readable still gets picked up.
                    continue;
                }
                frame.dataset.amplifyKeyBridge = '1';
                doc.addEventListener( 'keydown', onCaptureKeydown, true );
                log( 'bridged Escape into iframe', frame.id || '(anonymous)' );
            } catch {
                try {
                    frame.dataset.amplifyKeyBridge = 'unreachable';
                } catch {
                    // Frame is gone; nothing left to mark.
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Run an optional enhancement without letting it take the orchestrator down.
     *
     * The two hard rules must survive a broken third-party frame, so anything
     * that reaches outside our own state is isolated.
     *
     * @param {Function} fn    Work to attempt.
     * @param {string}   label Name to report if it fails.
     */
    function attempt( fn, label ) {
        try {
            fn();
        } catch ( error ) {
            // Third-party scripts on this page throw bare objects, not Errors
            // (Zoho PageSense's bot detection does exactly that), so do not
            // assume .message exists -- doing so turns a warning into a crash.
            warn( label + ' failed: ' + describeError( error ) );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Describe a thrown value that may not be an Error.
     *
     * @param {*} error Whatever was thrown.
     *
     * @return {string} Something readable.
     */
    function describeError( error ) {
        if ( ! error ) {
            return String( error );
        }
        if ( error.message ) {
            return error.message;
        }
        try {
            return JSON.stringify( error ).slice( 0, 200 );
        } catch {
            return Object.prototype.toString.call( error );
        }
    }

    function observe() {
        const observer = new MutationObserver( function () {
            // Reconciliation first and unguarded-by-others: enforcing the rules
            // must never depend on the optional helpers below succeeding.
            scheduleReconcile();
            attempt( tagPrivacyLink, 'tagPrivacyLink' );
            attempt( bindBannerButtons, 'bindBannerButtons' );
            attempt( bridgeIframeKeys, 'bridgeIframeKeys' );
        } );
        observer.observe( document.documentElement, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: [ 'class', 'style', 'hidden', 'aria-hidden' ],
        } );
    }

    function boot() {
        // Order matters: findTrigger() takes the first descriptor whose selector
        // matches, so the specific Salesforce chat link must be registered
        // before content-modal's catch-all [data-modal-id].
        registerCookieBanner();
        registerPrivacyChoices();
        registerSalesforceChat();
        registerContactModal();
        registerAiChat();
        registerSiteSearch();

        // Install the observer before anything that reaches into a third-party
        // frame, so a throw in an optional helper cannot leave the page with no
        // reconciliation at all. Both are themselves guarded: this page hosts
        // scripts that monkey-patch document.querySelector and throw from it,
        // and losing boot() to that would silently disable every rule.
        attempt( observe, 'observe' );
        attempt( reconcile, 'reconcile' );

        attempt( tagPrivacyLink, 'tagPrivacyLink' );
        attempt( bindBannerButtons, 'bindBannerButtons' );
        attempt( bridgeIframeKeys, 'bridgeIframeKeys' );

        // The banner may arrive after the grace window; keep checking for a
        // while so a late banner still closes the gate and a late resolution
        // still opens it. Most third-party frames also mount well after
        // DOMContentLoaded, so this is when they usually get bridged.
        let settleChecks = 0;
        const settle = window.setInterval( function () {
            settleChecks++;
            attempt( reconcile, 'reconcile' );
            attempt( tagPrivacyLink, 'tagPrivacyLink' );
            attempt( bindBannerButtons, 'bindBannerButtons' );
            attempt( bridgeIframeKeys, 'bridgeIframeKeys' );
            // Keep going for a few seconds even once consent is settled, to give
            // late-mounting frames a chance to be picked up.
            if ( settleChecks > 20 || ( consentSettled && settleChecks > 8 ) ) {
                window.clearInterval( settle );
            }
        }, 500 );
    }

    window.AmplifyModalManager = manager;

    // Runs at script-eval time, before the modal service can read the URL.
    captureDeepLink();

    // Capture phase: must see the click before the delegated bubble-phase
    // listeners in the theme bundle and the blocks-extended plugin.
    document.addEventListener( 'click', onCaptureClick, true );
    document.addEventListener( 'keydown', onCaptureKeydown, true );

    if ( document.readyState === 'loading' ) {
        document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', boot, { once: true } );
    } else {
        boot();
    }
} )();
</script>

<script>
/**
 * AI Search hotfix injection — no rebuild/deploy needed.
 *
 * v3 — dropped force-reload and the /?s= redirect fallback.
 *  - force-reload (recreating/cloning the widget.js script tag) is risky
 *    and unverified against Salespeak's internal state, AND Salespeak has
 *    confirmed this bug on their side and is shipping their own fix: a
 *    ~10s handshake watch, up to 2 reload attempts, and a visible
 *    "can't reach chat" message. Once that ships, our own reload logic
 *    would race against theirs — so it's removed now rather than left in
 *    to conflict later.
 *  - /?s= (native WP search) is itself currently broken (hangs
 *    indefinitely), so redirecting there on failure is worse than doing
 *    nothing.
 *
 * What's left is only the two bugs that are genuinely ours:
 *  - cold-load race: the original code did a single synchronous
 *    querySelector for `.launcher-container` on click, with no retry if
 *    Salespeak's script hadn't finished injecting it yet
 *  - toggle-state bug: the launcher element is removed from the DOM while
 *    the chat is open, so a second click while open would silently no-op
 *    instead of being recognized as "already open"
 *
 * The original js/components/ai-search/index.js listens on `document` for
 * clicks on [data-ai-search]. This script can't remove that listener (no
 * reference to it), so it intercepts the click FIRST via a capture-phase
 * listener and calls stopImmediatePropagation() to stop the old handler
 * from ever running, then re-implements the click behaviour with the fix.
 *
 * Paste as-is into GTM (custom HTML tag, fires on all pages) or directly
 * before </body> as a hotfix. Idempotent — safe if injected twice.
 */
( function () {
    if ( window.__aiSearchHotfixApplied ) {
        return;
    }
    window.__aiSearchHotfixApplied = true;

    var SALESPEAK_WIDGET_SELECTOR = '#salespeak-widget';
    var SALESPEAK_LAUNCHER_SELECTOR = '#salespeak-widget .launcher-container';
    var SALESPEAK_LAUNCHER_LOADING_CLASS = 'launcher-container--loading';
    var SALESPEAK_OPEN_CLASS = 'iframe-visible';
    var SALESPEAK_WAIT_TIMEOUT = 8000;

    function isWidgetOpen() {
        var widget = document.querySelector( SALESPEAK_WIDGET_SELECTOR );
        return !! widget && widget.classList.contains( SALESPEAK_OPEN_CLASS );
    }

    function getReadyLauncher() {
        var launcher = document.querySelector( SALESPEAK_LAUNCHER_SELECTOR );
        if ( launcher && ! launcher.classList.contains( SALESPEAK_LAUNCHER_LOADING_CLASS ) ) {
            return launcher;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function waitForLauncher( timeout ) {
        var existing = getReadyLauncher();
        if ( existing ) {
            return Promise.resolve( existing );
        }

        return new Promise( function ( resolve, reject ) {
            var timer = setTimeout( function () {
                observer.disconnect();
                reject( new Error( 'Salespeak launcher did not become ready in time.' ) );
            }, timeout );

            var observer = new MutationObserver( function () {
                var launcher = getReadyLauncher();
                if ( launcher ) {
                    observer.disconnect();
                    clearTimeout( timer );
                    resolve( launcher );
                }
            } );
            observer.observe( document.body, {
                childList: true,
                subtree: true,
                attributes: true,
                attributeFilter: [ 'class' ],
            } );
        } );
    }

    function openAiSearch() {
        if ( isWidgetOpen() ) {
            return;
        }

        waitForLauncher( SALESPEAK_WAIT_TIMEOUT )
            .then( function ( launcher ) {
                launcher.click();
            } )
            .catch( function () {
                // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
                console.warn( 'Salespeak launcher not found; AI search chat could not be opened.' );
            } );
    }

    // Capture phase + stopImmediatePropagation blocks the original
    // document-level bubble-phase listener from index.js before it runs.
    document.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function ( event ) {
            var trigger = event.target.closest( '[data-ai-search]' );
            if ( ! trigger ) {
                return;
            }
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            openAiSearch();
        },
        true
    );
} )();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
    // Inject CSS to allow JS to move the ::before cross icon via CSS variable
    var style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent =
        '.sync-comparison-rows .amplify-box--comparison-module .list-style-cross > li::before {' +
        '  top: var(--sync-icon-offset, -3px);' +
        '}';
    document.head.appendChild(style);

    function syncRows() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.sync-comparison-rows').forEach(function (wrap) {
            var boxes = wrap.querySelectorAll('.amplify-box--comparison-module');
            if (boxes.length !== 2) return;

            var leftLis = boxes[0].querySelectorAll('li');
            var rightLis = boxes[1].querySelectorAll('li');

            // Reset styles
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(leftLis, function (li) {
                li.style.minHeight = '';
            });
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(rightLis, function (li) {
                li.style.minHeight = '';
                li.style.paddingTop = '';
                li.style.removeProperty('--sync-icon-offset');
            });

            // Skip when columns are stacked (mobile)
            if (Math.abs(boxes[0].getBoundingClientRect().left - boxes[1].getBoundingClientRect().left) < 10) return;

            var count = Math.min(leftLis.length, rightLis.length);
            for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                var leftLi = leftLis[i];
                var rightLi = rightLis[i];
                var span = leftLi.querySelector('span.font-benton-sans');

                if (span) {
                    var offset = span.getBoundingClientRect().top - leftLi.getBoundingClientRect().top;
                    rightLi.style.paddingTop = offset + 'px';
